title: Explicit canonical affine-spectrum stalk chain coordinates
statement: Let X be an affine scheme, x a point of X, y a point of Spec Γ(X,top), h:x=X.isoSpec.inv(y), and P a cochain complex of module sheaves on X. With eA=canonicalSpectrumStalkEquiv X x y h [lem-pc-affine-spectrum-canonical-stalk-ring-coordinates], define an isomorphism from the module stalk complex P_x to Res_eA of the stalk at y of (X.isoSpec.inv)*P. Before transporting x by h, it is the extension/restriction adjunction unit for the invertible stalk map, followed by the inverse canonical pullback-stalk comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-pullback], whiskered with restriction of scalars. Lift this natural isomorphism degreewise to complexes, inserting functor composition isomorphisms. The pullback-stalk comparison is the one specified on every section germ; no arbitrary complex-isomorphism witness is chosen.

source.place: sheaves.tex, lemma-stalk-pullback-modules (Tag 0098); lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (Tag 0096); perfect.tex, lemma-single-complex-base-change-condition (Tag 0DJ8), affine reduction in the proof

proof.text: For an isomorphism j:Y→Z, its stalk ring map rho is bijective. Restriction and extension of scalars along rho are equivalences, so the extension/restriction unit is an isomorphism. Compose that unit with the inverse pullback-stalk natural isomorphism after restricting scalars. The germ specification of the latter determines the chosen map on generators.
Map the resulting natural isomorphism to cochain complexes and use mapHomologicalComplexCompIso twice to identify its target. The additive pullback and stalk functors preserve zero morphisms.
Specialize j=X.isoSpec.inv and transport x by h. Unfold canonicalSpectrumStalkEquiv only to identify the restriction-of-scalars ring map.

lean.statement:
def canonicalSpectrumStalkComplexIso
  (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (x : X) (y : Spec Γ(X, ⊤))
  (h : x = X.isoSpec.inv y)
  (P : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ) :
    ((((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≅
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (canonicalSpectrumStalkEquiv X x y h).toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor
          (Spec Γ(X, ⊤)).toRingedSpace y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
